Coverage_Description: Oral health education, oral examination, preventive treatment, basic restorative treatment, and emergency service during designated office hours; enrolled students receive one year of preventive/basic care
customer requirement: Primary school students under 18 as at 1 September; enrolment via participating-school joint form/online or individual clinic enrolment
price structure: Annual per-student flat fee tiered by Eligible Person vs Non-eligible Person status
additional informations: Joint enrolment with Student Health Service; payment request SMS starts in October; application is accepted only after full payment and fees are non-refundable
